status: Baseline fixtures added; production implementation unchanged.
scope: The non-Apple Unix sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE) call only. Apple Mach global access and Windows GetSystemInfo remain outside this increment.
contract: Convert the native c_long result to usize, returning zero when conversion fails. Preserve ordinary native errno behavior.
fixtures: Compare with independent getconf PAGESIZE and check successful-query errno preservation for zero, EIO and an arbitrary raw sentinel. Restore original errno before assertions.
local_baseline: Both fixtures passed in /tmp/martensite-page-size-baseline.log. Full cargo xtask pr passed in /tmp/martensite-page-size-baseline-pr.log.
candidate: Existing nix 0.31.3 exposes SysconfVar::PAGE_SIZE. Its sysconf wrapper clears errno before the native call, so compatibility requires preserving the incoming raw errno when the call leaves zero. Negative or absent values must retain the zero fallback.
deletion_gate: After baseline native validation and reviewed replacement evidence, delete the direct non-Apple Unix sysconf unsafe block. No public API or version change is planned.
remaining: Implement the safe query and cover result adaptation
